objective: Build a small deterministic OFFLINE original animal polyomino level candidate generator and exact-cover validator using existing approved shape metadata, so DESIGN can efficiently screen varied solvable levels. Do not copy source game's fixed level layouts or replace the playable first level.

reference_research.purpose: Internal analysis of design distributions/solver conventions, not release-level coordinates.
reference_research.research_zip: Dogs_Geometry_Research_Package(1).zip (conversation attachment, NOT automatically present on Codex local Windows)
reference_research.verified_structure: 80 levels,30 mobile shapes, 21 blocker catalog entries including 20 irregular+single, and solver rule specification
reference_research.access_policy: Do not assume this chat attachment is in local Codex workspace. Implement against original shape metadata already in GitHub; importing research zip is optional and never a blocker. No level JSON from the reference is to be copied into release data.

locked_design.reference_level: Keep human-accepted first-level 5x4 6+4+6+4 exactly unchanged; it is a calibration fixture not newly generated content.
locked_design.generation_strategy: Construct-from-solution or exact cover with randomized seeded placement; ensure each candidate's original instance placements form at least one valid proof solution, then enumerate all legal solutions/allowed quarter turns for verification. Unique solution NOT required.
locked_design.board_policy: Allow rectangular boards up to 6x6 in the experiment; choose candidates whose playable area exactly matches available instances. Do not assume arbitrary 5x5 with only 4-/6-cell pieces is fillable. Any unavailable cells are explicit fixed blocked positions, not phantom visual animal cells.
locked_design.legal_pieces: Each animal is ONE atomic draggable piece. Multiple instances of same approved sprite are allowed. Only quarter-turn rotations, no reflections; dedupe normalized orientations.
locked_design.seed: Every generated result records deterministic PRNG seed and generator version; replay must produce the exact same canonical board signature.
locked_design.deduplication: Within generated candidates canonicalize board occupancy/fixed geometry and shape-instance assignments; treat repeated indistinguishable animals as interchangeable. Do not claim geometric isomorphism dedup across 90deg board rotation/reflection without explicit implementation. Log what equivalence relation is actually used.
locked_design.difficulty: For V0.1 collect movable-piece count, distinct shape count, rotations required by example solution, fixed area, exact-cover solution count and branching/placement indicators. These are proxies, NOT proven human difficulty; avoid arbitrary pass/fail cutoffs.
locked_design.release_constraint: Generated levels remain candidate-only until DESIGN selects, original image cells and background geometry match, browser G4 and HUMAN first chapter playtest. No DOGS original coordinates/images/source code copied.

build_scope: Single locally runnable CLI (Node or Python matching existing repo) that takes a config and deterministic seed and emits JSON with board width/height, blocked cells, list of whole animal IDs/occupied cells/instances, at least one exact-cover solution and basic difficulty proxy metrics.

Generate at least 12 mathematically distinct candidate geometries across minimum two shape-instance counts or board/blocker compositions, unless demonstrably infeasible with two types; document feasible search space and avoid lowering correctness to hit a quota.

Independent exact-cover solver validates imported candidate data, rotational normalization, fixed blockers, collision, total area, instance identity and identical-instance dedup; report solution count and termination/cap status. Do not call limited-count 1000+ exact count unless full enumeration complete.
Avoid comparing candidates to all 80 source geometry items or porting source level coordinates. Derive quality goals from abstract distributions only; source ZIP is not a required runtime input.
Deduplicate within output batch and supply informative short report for DESIGN. Retain a few notably different candidates; no visual sprites generated and no new animal art tasks.

Repro tests include seed repeatability, total-area checks, intentionally unsatisfiable fixture, blocked-cell overlap, duplicate equivalent instance, rotation and exact-cover count; verify known first-level count 16 with instance labels / 4 after same-type exchange as regression fixture.
Do not modify current player runtime, finished first level, approved panda/rabbit bytes or chapter background. Do not build complex level editor/generic engine or new production framework.

output.code_root: tools/level_generator/ (or minimal justified existing compatible path)
output.human_review: DESIGN chooses what content to make; HUMAN later approves major chapter content scope and visual/gameplay experience

acceptance: Generator can run offline with existing two approved shapes and seed
Candidate JSON has explicit unique instance IDs and independent piece state representation
Every exported candidate has at least one completed exact-cover proof, and no invalid placements
All counts and equivalence conventions labelled; max-limit truncation reported, not presented as full solution count
12 different geometry candidates where feasible and at least 2 structural setups tested
No imported DOGS level coordinates/art/code in game/release data
Existing first-level browser replay and asset bytes unchanged
Concise source test and run commands and Git commit recorded; not called RELEASE_READY
next_owner_action: Codex implement generator V0.1 autonomously, validate and commit evidence. DESIGN then select original generated candidate levels and request only shapes necessary for approved chapters.
